# pve_firewall_security_group (Data Source)

Reads a single security group's metadata from `GET /cluster/firewall/groups`. The group's rules are exposed by `pve_security_group_firewall_rules`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_firewall_security_group" "web" {
  group = "web"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group` (String) Security Group name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String) Optional comment or description, or null when the group has none.
